title: Apple Explores Turning Siri AI Into ChatGPT Dots-Like Agent; iOS 28 Shake-Up
summary: The company wants to turn Siri into a true AI agent.

title: Voters Put the AI Data Center Boom on Notice
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News tech reporter Brody Ford explains how voter backlash against data centers could disrupt the rapid buildout of infrastructure powering the AI boom. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Ford discusses the risks for heavily indebted AI companies and whether tougher promises from newly elected officials will translate into meaningful restrictions on development. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Asia Markets Brace for More AI Volatility
summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News Markets producer Anthony Stephens says Asian investors are assessing the fallout from the AI selloff as hedge funds cut exposure and uncertainty grows over US data-center policy. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Stephens explains why the timing of AI infrastructure investment could determine the next winners and losers across technology markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Anthropic Buys Power for AI Data Centers in $3.4B Deal, FT Says
summary: Anthropic PBC has agreed to pay $3.4 billion for gas-fired generators for data centers, the FT reported, in what it described as the largest known single purchase of power-generation equipment by an AI lab.

title: CoreWeave Asks Texas Governor-Elect for Data Center Cooperation
summary: CoreWeave Inc. sent a letter to Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa seeking to work with her incoming administration on present and future data center projects in the state.

title: AI Backlash Spreads Across Europe With Data Center Protests
summary: Protests against data centers continued across Europe on Saturday as citizens took to the streets to voice their concerns about the impact on society and the environment.
